subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Parts of speech Top Tip, vocabulary matching and sentences / Cruises: reading, vocabulary matching and crossword
outcomes: Find a word's part of speech before matching its meaning
Learn and use new tourism words
Read about cruises and solve a word crossword

tf.why: Yes, it describes how something happens.

tf.s: 'Flock' means to stay at home alone.
tf.why: 'Flock' means to go somewhere in large numbers.

tf.s: A cruise is a holiday on a large ship.
tf.why: Yes, cruise passengers travel by sea.
A voyage is a journey by sea.
'Variety' is a noun: a variety of goods.

tf.s: Cruise ships have no shops or fitness centres.
tf.why: Cruise ships have many amenities, like shops and fitness centres.

boxes.why: We say 'a variety of', so it is a noun.

boxes.q: What does 'major' mean as a noun?
boxes.why: As a noun, a major is an army officer.

boxes.q: Who are the 'staff' on a ship?
What are 'amenities' on a cruise ship?
boxes.why: Amenities are useful and pleasant facilities.

boxes.q: Why are cruise ships called floating hotels?
o: They offer luxurious rooms at sea
boxes.why: They have hotel comfort on the sea.

boxes.q: Complete: The souq sells a ___ of goods.
boxes.why: A variety means many different kinds.
It describes a noun, like 'a massive ship'.
Luxury is comfort and expensive things.

hunt.q: A holiday on a large ship

mcq.q: What is the Top Tip for matching meanings?
o: Choose a meaning with the same part of speech as the headword
mcq.why: The meaning must be the same part of speech.

mcq.q: Which list shows four parts of speech?
mcq.why: These are the four main parts of speech.

mcq.q: Which word means 'the most important one of a group', like a company's main ship?
mcq.why: A flagship is the leading or most important one.

mcq.q: Which amenities does the text say cruise ships have?
mcq.why: Cruise ships have many facilities on board.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: The festival ___ many tourists.
Choose the best word: Tourists ___ to the beach every summer.
mcq.why: People flock to a place in large numbers.

o: The number of tourists has grown steadily.
mcq.why: 'Steadily' is an adverb describing a verb.

mcq.q: Why must a meaning be the same part of speech as the headword?
o: Words of different parts of speech cannot match each other
The longest word is always right
Nouns and verbs are the same
mcq.why: A noun matches a noun, a verb matches a verb.

mcq.q: 'Major' can be a noun meaning an army officer. In 'a major city', what part of speech is it?
mcq.why: Here it describes 'city', so it is an adjective.

mcq.q: Would people who love comfort enjoy a cruise?
o: Yes, because cruise ships offer luxury and many amenities
No, because ships have no rooms
No, because cruise ships have no staff
Yes, because cruises are always free
mcq.why: Cruise ships are like floating luxury hotels.
